The only way to get that information is to obtain its ¹H NMR spectrum, which the `proton_nmr_spectra` tool can provide without requiring additional arguments (the system likely has a predefined compound for this subtask). By analyzing the spectrum and counting distinct signals, we can determine the number of chemically equivalent hydrogen types.</thought>
